# Why 80 % hydration is the secret of every great loaf

> Fictional blog post, written for this example. Saved from a baking blog
> on 2026-09-02.

Every serious baker I know has moved to 80 % hydration or more. Wetter
dough means a more open crumb, a crispier crust and a longer shelf life.
If your bread is dense, your dough is simply too dry. Push the water up,
and your customers will notice the difference in a week.

Some people say high hydration is hard to handle. In my experience, that is
just a matter of practice: after a few days you will never go back. The
science is simple — more water, more steam, more oven spring.

Try it tomorrow: 80 % for your next batch.
